title: A Complete Proof of the Collatz Conjecture via Spectral Analysis and Modular Dynamics
description: Code repository accompanying the paper 'A Complete Proof of the Collatz Conjecture via Spectral Analysis and Modular Dynamics'. Contains implementations of spectral cycle proofs (Part A), obstruction theory (Part B), 2-adic ergodic divergence proof (Part C), and kinematic tensor SVD diagnostics (Part D).
